_comment: production-shaped IF selection aggregate with a CONDITION SIGN FLIP for Issue #1738. The condition neuron (neuron-cond) drives the IF branch choice: on the committed window (see tests/issue_1738_aggregation_squash_impact_characterisation.rs) the summed condition contribution is > 0 on half the observations (positive branch selected) and <= 0 on the other half (negative branch selected). Neither branch is dominated (the F1 mixed-condition case). The always-active condition synapse must carry full impact (1.0); the positive and negative branch impacts must equal their branch-selection fractions and sum to the aggregate impact. Fixtures only - no engine behaviour change. Input neurons are implicit (referenced as input-N).
